name: Fundamentals of Electrochemistry for Clinical Application
description: The course covers the fundamentals of electrochemistry, including electrode types, electrode potential, iontronic interfaces and electron transfer theory. It explores ionic conduction, electrode reactions, and essential electrochemical techniques, including voltammetry, amperometry, and impedance spectroscopy. Key topics include electrochemical kinetics, double-layer effects, electrode passivation, and the role of conductive polymers. Students will also learn surface characterisation methods like QCM, X-ray, and scanning probe techniques. The course concludes with biomedical applications, focusing on electrochemical biosensors, glucometers, and other diagnostic devices.
